# Blood products

The outcome is the count of administered red-blood-cell and platelet products.
Exposure is observed follow-up time in days.  The adjusted model follows the
historical SAP specification: Bayesian negative binomial with treatment,
linear age, and diagnosis/cancer category, with `log(observed_follow_up_days)`
as the offset.  The compact result artifact reports posterior rate,
rate-ratio, and rate-difference summaries.

Rows with unknown product types are retained as a missingness/quality flag;
they are not silently recoded as zero.  A patient with no qualifying event has
count zero only when the event-level table is available and complete.

```{r}
#| eval: false

source(here::here("analysis", "05-secondary", "secondary-helpers.R"))
source(here::here("R", "count-helpers.R"))
source(here::here("R", "paths-artifacts.R"))
source(here::here("R", "data-validation.R"))

cohort <- read_pseudonymized_parquet(
  here::here("analysis", "00-data", "results", "analysis-cohort.parquet"),
  schema = here::here("data", "schema", "cohort_follow_up.yml")
)
products_path <- here::here(
  "analysis", "00-data", "results", "analysis-blood-products.parquet"
)
if (!file.exists(products_path)) {
  stop(
    "Blood-products analysis is pending: the audited input contract contains " ,
    "only participant-level aggregates and no approved event-level product table; " ,
    "an aggregate is not substituted for event-level counts."
  )
}
products <- read_pseudonymized_parquet(
  products_path,
  schema = here::here("data", "schema", "blood_products.yml")
)

# Count administered red-cell and platelet product records.  A complete event
# table with no qualifying row gives an observed zero; missing product fields
# are retained as missing/quality flags and are never recoded as zero.
transfusion <- as.numeric(products$transfusion)
product_type <- tolower(trimws(as.character(products$product_type)))
product_type <- gsub("[_-]+", " ", product_type)
product_type <- ifelse(
  product_type %in% c("red blood cell", "red blood cells", "rbc",
                      "packed red blood cell", "packed red blood cells"),
  "red_blood_cell",
  ifelse(product_type %in% c("platelet", "platelets", "platelet product",
                             "platelet products"), "platelet", NA_character_)
)
administered <- transfusion == 1 & !is.na(product_type)
count_table <- as.data.frame(table(as.character(products$id[administered])),
                             stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
names(count_table) <- c("id", "n_blood_products")
count_table$n_blood_products <- as.integer(count_table$n_blood_products)
blood_data <- secondary_observed_follow_up(
  cohort, origin_col = "randomization_date", horizon_days = 182L,
  output_col = "observed_follow_up_days"
)
blood_data <- secondary_join_count(blood_data, count_table, "n_blood_products")
secondary_count_ready(blood_data, "n_blood_products", "observed_follow_up_days")

# Exact adjusted SAP count model: Bayesian negative binomial with observed-time
# offset, treatment, linear age, and diagnosis/cancer category.
blood_formula <- n_blood_products ~ 1 + tx + age + diagnosis +
  offset(log(observed_follow_up_days))
blood_fit <- rstanarm::stan_glm(
  formula = blood_formula,
  data = blood_data,
  family = rstanarm::neg_binomial_2(),
  chains = 4,
  iter = 1000,
  warmup = 500,
  seed = 17006
)
write_atomic_parquet(
  data.frame(
    outcome = "blood_products",
    model = "Bayesian negative binomial",
    adjustment = "tx + linear age + diagnosis",
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ),
  project_path("results", "secondary", "blood-products", "status.parquet")
)
```
